summary: Largo Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a news release dated August 14, 2026, reporting Q2 2026 financial results. The release highlights a 68% revenue increase and positive adjusted EBITDA, driven by higher vanadium production and prices, offset by raw material input cost pressures. It also announces guidance for new copper-platinum group metals (PGM) by-product production, with projected output of 300-380 tonnes per month. The filing is a routine earnings and operational update, containing no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review. The registrant is reporting results, not engaging in a corporate transaction.
